# Community Lexicon fixtures

These unmodified schema snapshots were retrieved from the community-owned repository on 13 November 2026 and are used only for offline cross-reference validation. The schemas are MIT-licensed by Lexicon Community.

- [Geo source](https://tangled.org/lexicon.community/lexicons/blob/main/community/lexicon/location/geo.json)
- [AI preferences source](https://tangled.org/lexicon.community/lexicons/blob/main/community/lexicon/preference/ai.json)

Production Lexicons reference the published community NSIDs; these copies are not published under the Aster namespace.
